fact: The southern passage opens into an immense cavern carpeted with oozes.
source_quote: The southern passage opened into an immense cavern carpeted with more oozes than the party had ever seen
subject: The Ooze Cavern

fact: Green slime coats the cavern walls.
source_quote: Green slime coated the cavern walls
subject: The Ooze Cavern

fact: A great spherical structure stands upon stone pillars at the center of the cavern.
source_quote: a great spherical structure stood upon stone pillars at the center
subject: The Ooze Cavern

fact: Dozens of oozes crawl around the pillars extending grasping pseudopods.
source_quote: Dozens of oozes crawled around those pillars, extending grasping pseudopods
subject: oozes

fact: A disembodied voice addresses the visitors and proclaims the coming of the Faceless Lord.
source_quote: A disembodied voice addressed the visitors and proclaimed the coming of the “Faceless Lord,”
subject: proclamation of Faceless Lord

fact: The surrounding oozes urge Glabbagool to join them, but he refuses.
source_quote: The surrounding oozes urged Glabbagool to join them, but he refused.
subject: Glabbagool

fact: Glabbagool senses something not nice about the assembled oozes.
source_quote: He liked the party and sensed “something not nice” about the assembled oozes.
subject: Glabbagool

fact: Glabbagool notes that oozes don't talk and finds this weird.
source_quote: More importantly, “Oozes don’t talk. Something’s weird.”
subject: Glabbagool

fact: Gyrgum recalls that Juiblex was also known as the Faceless Lord.
source_quote: Gyrgum recalled that Juiblex was also known as the Faceless Lord
subject: Gyrgum

fact: Gyrgum connects the scene to an earlier ghost’s warning that devils create contracts while demons infuse creatures with power.
source_quote: connected the scene to an earlier ghost’s warning: devils create contracts, while demons infuse creatures or objects with power to generate chaos and mayhem.
subject: ghost's warning

fact: The party concludes that Juiblex is probably working through a local proxy rather than appearing personally.
source_quote: The party concluded that Juiblex was probably working through a local proxy rather than appearing personally.
subject: party conclusion on Juiblex

fact: Daz summons a bat familiar and names him Batman.
source_quote: Daz summoned a bat familiar and named him Batman.
subject: Batman summoning

fact: Batman conducts a breadth-first reconnaissance of the surrounding passages.
source_quote: Batman conducted a breadth-first reconnaissance of the surrounding passages.
subject: Batman

fact: Batman finds abandoned remnants of the old gnomish settlement.
source_quote: He found abandoned remnants of the old gnomish settlement
subject: abandoned remnants of the old gnomish settlement

fact: Batman finds dripping caves occupied by scattered oozes.
source_quote: dripping caves occupied by scattered oozes
subject: caves occupied by scattered oozes

fact: Batman finds wreckage scoured clean and the ruins of a fungal partition.
source_quote: wreckage scoured clean, and the ruins of a fungal partition.
subject: ruins of a fungal partition

fact: In another cave, phosphorescent lichen illuminates pools and hanging drapes of green slime.
source_quote: In another cave, phosphorescent lichen illuminated pools and hanging drapes of green slime.
subject: lichen-lit cave

fact: A slime-covered throne faces east at the center of the lichen-lit cave.
source_quote: A slime-covered throne faced east at its center.
subject: slime-covered throne

fact: A small gnome sits upon the throne holding court like an insane monarch.
source_quote: A small gnome sat upon that throne, holding court like an insane monarch.
subject: Pudding King

fact: The Pudding King speaks of cleansing Blingdenstone of everyone who had irritated him.
source_quote: He spoke of cleansing Blingdenstone of everyone who had irritated him
subject: Pudding King

fact: The Pudding King declares that he would become king of Blingdenstone.
source_quote: declared that the Pudding King would become king of Blingdenstone.
subject: Pudding King

fact: Glabbagool and the party recognize the Pudding King's voice as the one projected through the great ooze cavern.
source_quote: Glabbagool and the party recognized his voice as the one projected through the great ooze cavern.
subject: voice identification

fact: The Pudding King does not appear particularly formidable.
source_quote: The Pudding King himself did not appear particularly formidable
subject: Pudding King

fact: Hundreds of oozes and slime cover the Pudding King's chamber, making a direct attack impractical.
source_quote: but hundreds of oozes and the slime covering his chamber made a direct attack impractical.
subject: Pudding King's chamber

fact: Daz earns inspiration for using Batman to identify the enemy without exposing the party.
source_quote: Daz’s use of Batman had allowed the party to identify the enemy without exposing themselves, earning him inspiration.
subject: Daz earns inspiration
